It was built to test a tool that turns a structured document into Markdown for hosts like this one.*

blocks.tagline: Small-batch everyday carry. Machined in Sheffield, shipped worldwide.

blocks.text:
Everything here is made in runs of forty or fewer, finished by hand, and checked twice before it goes in a box.

Stock is **live**: if an item is listed, it is on the shelf. When a run sells out the line comes off this page rather than sitting here as a *coming soon*.

New drops go out to the [mailing list](https://ridgelinecarry.example/list) two days before they appear here.

blocks.heading: How to order
blocks.text:
- Send the [order form](https://ridgelinecarry.example/order) with the item name and any options.
- We reply within two working days with a total and an invoice.
- Work starts when the invoice is paid. Nothing is held without payment.
- You get a photograph before it is boxed.

blocks.heading: Shipping
blocks.text:
Everything ships tracked and signed-for. Cut-off is 2pm UK time.

- **United Kingdom**, Royal Mail Special Delivery, $9, next working day.

- **Europe**, DHL, $22, three to five working days.

- **United States and Canada**, DHL, $28, four to seven working days.

- **Rest of world**, DHL, $34, seven to fourteen working days.

Orders over $250 ship free within the UK and Europe. Import duty and local taxes are the buyer's responsibility and are not included in the price above.

Knives cannot be shipped to some countries and to some US states. If we cannot legally ship to you we will say so before taking payment, not after.

blocks.heading: Returns and warranty
blocks.text:
Unused items can go back within 30 days of arrival for a full refund, less return postage. Say so by email first so we can expect it.

Anything made to order, engraved or monogrammed cannot be returned unless it is faulty, because we cannot sell it to anyone else.

Everything carries a *lifetime warranty against manufacturing defect*: pivots, locks, stitching, and finish. Wear, corrosion from being left wet, and damage from prying or throwing are not defects. We will still fix those, at cost, and tell you the price first.

blocks.heading: Terms and conditions
blocks.text:
- **Age.** Bladed items are sold only to buyers aged 18 or over. Placing an order is a declaration that you are.
- **Lead time.** In-stock items leave within three working days. Made-to-order runs are quoted at the time of ordering and are typically four to six weeks.
- **Prices** are in US dollars and include UK VAT where it applies. The price you are invoiced is the price at the time of the invoice.
- **Cancellation.** An order can be cancelled for a full refund at any point before work starts on it.
- **Photographs** on this page are of the actual production items. Natural material varies; grain, patina and anodised colour will not match a photograph exactly.
- **Contact.** hello@ridgelinecarry.example, replies within two working days, Monday to Friday.
